act_title: The Integrated Goods and Services Tax Act, 2017
title: Place of supply of goods imported into, or exported from India.––The place of supply of
text:
11. Place of supply of goods imported into, or exported from India.––The place of supply of

goods,––

(a) imported into India shall be the location of the importer;

(b) exported from India shall be the location outside India.
